# dsh-rightbar-quicknav
**Right-sidebar quick navigation for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — a vertical icon rail that jumps straig
ht to any right-sidebar tab.**
> English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Español · Português · हिन्दी
## What it does
DSH puts every right-sidebar feature (Files, Git, Tasks, Terminal, Browser, Image Studio, Memory…) b
ehind a tab strip you have to open first. This plugin adds a **standing icon rail** directly under t
he *open right sidebar* button:

- **Collapsed, it shows only 3 icons** — almost invisible until you need it.
- **Hover it** and it e

xpands downward to reveal every available tab.
- **Hover an icon** and its title appears in a compac

t bubble.
- **Click an icon** and the right sidebar opens straight on that tab — one click instead o

.
- **Click an icon** and the right sidebar opens straight on that tab — one click instead of three.
The list is not hard-coded: it is read from the host's own tab registry (`sidebarRightTabs.guide()`)
, so any plugin that registers a tab appears in the rail automatically.
## Install
### Through the plugin manager (recommended)
`Plugins → Add` and point it at this package (npm tarball or a local directory). The bundle patch wi
res the client half into the Web/Desktop profile.
### Manual
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then **restart DSH completely** — client modules are composed at boot, a page refresh is not enough.
## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.1` (needs the `sidebarRightTabs` / `sidebarRight` client services)
- React provid
ed by the host — this plugin has **no runtime dependencies** and **no build step**
## Behaviour details

tton |

| Expand | hover (200 ms collapse delay when the pointer leaves) |

## Design boundaries

- Mounts **only** into the additive `shell.overlay` slot — never covers or replaces shipped UI.
- Al
l visuals are **inline React styles**: the host exposes no `styles` service, so class-based CSS woul

d silently do nothing.
- Geometry is **event-driven** (`MutationObserver` + `ResizeObserver`), with

zero polling and zero forced layout in steady state.
- The anchor is the host's own button, located
by the stable attribute `data-sidebar-right-expand`, with an `aria-label` fallback; if neither match
es, the rail falls back to a default position and logs one warning instead of disappearing or mis-an

choring.
- Keyboard accessible: the rail is a `toolbar` with roving tabindex and arrow keys, `Esc` c

loses the tooltip, focus outline is keyboard-only.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`; a render-tim

e exception is caught by an ErrorBoundary instead of blanking the slot.
- UI strings are bilingual (
zh / en) and registered under the `rightbarQuicknav` locale namespace when the host provides one.

## Development

The render smoke test loads the real `client.js`, drives the plugin's own `apply() → slots.inject →
slots.register` path with a minimal React stub, and asserts that rendering and effects do not throw.
It exists because a single undefined identifier in an effect once made the whole rail silently disa
ists because a single undefined identifier in an effect once made the whole rail silently disappear.
## Releasing
Releases are published **by CI, never from a developer machine**.
1. bump `version` in `package.json` **and** the `VERSION` constant in `client.js` — they must match

2. add a `## [x.y.z]` section to `CHANGELOG.md`
3. commit to `main`
4. `git tag vX.Y.Z && git push o

[x.y.z]` section to `CHANGELOG.md`
3. commit to `main`
4. `git tag vX.Y.Z && git push origin vX.Y.Z`
Pushing the tag runs `.github/workflows/publish.yml`, which:

- asserts tag == `package.json` version == `client.js` `VERSION` (`scripts/verify-version.mjs`)
- ru

ns the syntax check and tests
- publishes with **npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC)** plus a provenance s

tatement — no `NPM_TOKEN`, no 2FA prompt
- **waits until npm actually serves the version**: `npm pub
lish` reports success while the version is still in npm's processing queue, so a green job that stop

ped there would be a false positive
- packs the tarball and creates the GitHub Release from the matc
hing CHANGELOG section
Local `npm publish` is intentionally unavailable for this package: its publishing access requires 2F
A and disallows bypass-2FA tokens, so a local publish only lands in npm's queue.
If `github.com:443` is unreachable from your machine, `node scripts/push-via-api.mjs` pushes the sam
e tree through the Git Data API (identical tree hash, different commit SHA).
